decisions.head: accede
decisions.reason: Explicit participle/gerund mapping plus the agree-or-express-agreement sense supports the TOEIC agreement context. Publish the verb form, not the unverified equivalence to an affirmative adjective.

decisions.head: accoutrement
decisions.reason: The plural mapping resolves identity and WordNet supplies the clothing-accessory meaning, relevant to the kit context. No claim that this covers every kind of equipment or exact synonym edge is published.

decisions.head: adjudicator
decisions.reason: Explicit plural of the sourced person-who-settles-disputes sense is relevant to the NGSL jury/legal context. The definition does not equate an individual adjudicator with a jury and no such edge is approved.

decisions.head: adornment
decisions.reason: The exact plural link and concrete decoration sense support the TOEIC jewelry context. Publish the broader decoration meaning without claiming all adornments are jewelry.
The spelling relation now verifies air base, but its military-aircraft meaning remains unrelated to the ordinary Business/TOEIC airport context. Keep specialist content hidden.
The spaced source confirms military aircraft collectively, not ordinary Business aviation. Spelling repair does not resolve topic relevance; retain hidden.
The new a la preposition and Alabama abbreviation are unrelated to the intended wing noun. Anatomical/botanical wing senses remain specialist and ungrounded in this NGSL context.

decisions.head: appointment
decisions.reason: Select the explicitly usually-plural furnishings/equipment sense, matching the NGSL furniture anchor. The source plural link resolves identity; scheduled meetings and positions are not substituted.
The plural identity is now sourced, but both base senses concern military weapons or preparation for war, not the intended general hardware context. Retain unrelated specialist content hidden.
The proposed spaced phrase returned no exact usable entry from the checked free sources, including the new Wiktionary and OEWN lookups. Do not manufacture a definition from its parts.
The exact capitalized mapping yields BMW or IBM slang, not projector. The intended projector use remains chiefly non-native in the existing evidence; no suitable release.

decisions.head: beam
decisions.reason: Explicit noun plural with the long structural wood/metal/concrete member sense resolves the timber-context gap. Light, broadcasting and gymnastics senses are excluded.

decisions.head: betting shop
decisions.reason: Exact WordNet spaced headword supports historical space-loss repair. A licensed bookmaker's shop fits the casino/gambling-business topic, while remaining distinct from a casino; no synonym edge is approved.

The alternative spaced definition only says labor without wages. It does not resolve the prior legal/historical distinction between indenture and slavery sufficiently for this learner record; retain uncertainty hidden.

decisions.head: bovine
decisions.reason: Wiktionary explicitly verifies the noun plural and WordNet identifies members of genus Bos. This is directly relevant to the existing cattle anchors; do not broaden it to every animal in the larger biological subfamily.

decisions.head: canapé
decisions.reason: The English Wiktionary appetizer sense verifies the accented canapé repair and directly fits TOEIC food vocabulary. Exclude the furniture sense and retain the original stable identifier.

decisions.head: capital punishment
decisions.reason: Exact WordNet phrase verifies the historical collapsed spelling and legal execution meaning. Limit scope to Academic legal discussion, not Business task execution.

decisions.head: card stock
decisions.reason: The explicit alternative-spelling relation and full paper-material definition resolve the previous evidence gap. Appropriate to NGSL paper, with source countability labels retained.

decisions.head: chronicle
decisions.reason: Exact past/participle mapping plus record-in-chronological-order meaning is appropriate to historical accounts. Publish the verb form without asserting it means the adjective historical.

decisions.head: clavicle
decisions.reason: Explicit English alternative-form relation and the human collarbone definition establish identity and direct Fitness anatomy relevance. Exclude fish-bone meaning and retain both source references.

Follow-up exact noun evidence supplies a store of organizational money; the prior explicit plural mapping now resolves the intended Business treasury sense. Exclude containers and architectural panels.
decisions.head: coffer
colonize
decisions.reason: Source explicitly identifies the participle/gerund and defines establishing a colony. This fits Academic colonial-history context, without equating an ongoing process to a colonial adjective or business expansion.

decisions.head: commodity
decisions.reason: The exact noun-plural relation with articles-of-commerce definition verifies traded goods in the existing economics/merchandise anchors. No unsupported raw-material-only restriction is added.

decisions.head: communiqué
decisions.reason: English Wiktionary supplies an official-report-or-statement meaning under the accented headword. This verifies the lost-accent repair and the existing bulletin/advisory communication context.

decisions.head: component
decisions.reason: Exact noun-plural mapping and concrete individual-part-of-composite definition support the NGSL contents/parts context. No unrelated mathematical component or synonym edge is approved.

decisions.head: computerised
decisions.reason: The original source explicitly calls computerized the American/Oxford spelling of computerised. The latter's computer-mediated/digital adjective sense resolves the cross-reference while preserving American spelling and NGSL electronic context.

decisions.head: consommé
decisions.reason: English Wiktionary's clear-broth definition verifies the lost-accent repair and matches TOEIC soup. Preserve source countability and hot/chilled distinction without adding an invented example.

decisions.head: constituent
decisions.reason: Select the sourced concrete component-part sense via explicit plural relation for NGSL content. Do not blend voters into this definition or release the Business constituency association.

decisions.head: court tennis
decisions.reason: The exact spaced source phrase defines the ancient four-walled-court form of tennis. This verifies identity and sports relevance while explicitly preserving its distinction from modern lawn tennis.

decisions.head: coverall
decisions.reason: The original noun gloss explicitly links coveralls to coverall, and the target defines the protective jumpsuit. Preserve plural-only US labeling and the sourced clothing meaning, not an inferred generic overall adjective.
